approval_basis: Repository owner direction in working session 2026-09-20: store College Board labels in their own columns; keep generated primary keys; additive only; Option B (do not overload the reading-only skill_family_key). No rule-document amendment exists for VOC-0004: amendment promotion can only add a value to an existing vocabulary and cannot create one.
release_kind: minor — adds compatible terms and mappings; nothing renamed, removed, split, merged or reparented

meaning.mapping_relationship: equivalent to the official skill; Command of Evidence equivalent to the official testing points
meaning.note: SKILL_FAMILY_KEYS has 11 values for the 10 official skills because Command of Evidence is split textual/quantitative, as READING_SKILL_FAMILY_KEYS already did.

evidence.source: College Board MyPractice Question Bank exports, Sep 2026; CB_QUESTION_BANK/09_2026/audit_labels.py
evidence.finding: 1,845 unique questions, exactly 10 Domain x Skill pairs, zero label conflicts across 4,465 label rows
evidence.reason: Grammar-domain questions had no field able to hold an official skill: skill_family_key is validator-restricted to reading values.

changes.compatibility: new concept; every existing category, key, parent and meaning unchanged

writers: backend/app/pipeline/skill_key.py via ingest, generate and reannotate
consumers.prompts: unchanged — the skill is derived, not emitted by a model
consumers.validators: unchanged; the reading-only checks on skill_family_key are retained deliberately

changes.rollback: Remove the two vocabularies from vocabulary/master.json and regenerate with scripts/gen_vocab.py --generate.

changes.meaning: questions.cb_question_id, cb_domain_key, cb_skill_key, cb_difficulty retain College Board's own labels (STANDARD.md adoption step 2: retain source labels). cb_skill_key holds the 10 official skills with Command of Evidence unsplit. cb_question_id changed from UNIQUE to a plain index because the database stores about two copies of each question.

evidence.result: 733 bank questions matched to 1,414 of 1,514 official rows; 11 held for human review; 0 rows claimed by two bank IDs

changes.compatibility: new columns; no existing column or JSONB key changed

migration.selection: rows matched on passage+stem text and answer choices
migration.validation: 0 partially labelled rows; 0 questions whose copies disagree; pairs are exactly the 10 official ones; second run changed 0 rows; checksum guard on all non-cb columns

identity.reviewer: repository owner (Option B chosen in session)

changes.meaning: questions.skill_key carries the official skill for every question, alongside the internal classification (STANDARD.md adoption steps 2-4). skill_key_source records the method: cb, annotation, map, or manual.

evidence.crosswalk_validation: v1.0.0 crosswalk.json agrees with College Board ground truth on 95.5% of matched rows; 23 of 27 testable entries are >=95% pure. The two weak grammar entries, comma_splice (71%) and run_on_sentence (90%), are the same two the derived map marks review.
evidence.derived_map: vocabulary/mappings/cb_skill_map.json, generated by CB_QUESTION_BANK/09_2026/calibration_report.py; rules are auto-applied only at n>=5 and purity>=95%

migration.ambiguous: 17 rows left NULL for review rather than guessed (16 are complete_the_text / expression_of_ideas / precision_word_choice, which is 89% Words in Context)
migration.validation: annotation_jsonb checksum identical before and after; second run changed 0 rows; 12 unit tests in backend/tests/test_skill_key.py

changes.history: original annotations and versions preserved; no QuestionVersion written
changes.known_conflicts_preserved: existing annotations disagree with College Board on 201 question_family_key values and 22 reading skill_family_key values, and 79 Words in Context rows are annotated as grammar. Reported, not rewritten.

changes.reason: backend/app/models/ontology.py and the VOCAB appendix of rules_agent_dsat_grammar_ingestion_generation_v8.md regenerated from master.json. The appendix also gained two blocks that were missing before this release (SYNTACTIC_TRAP_REQUIRED_ROLES, GRAMMAR_QUESTION_FAMILY_KEYS). No accepted value changed.
